'''Kusk''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He was stationed aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''[[Tradewyn]]'' in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]. His actual motive aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was to capture either [[Raynar Thul|Raynar]] or [[Aryn Dro Thul]], then escape in a ship to meet up with his brother aboard the ''[[High Roller]]''. Luckily, his plan was foiled by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Tenel Ka Djo]], and he was arrested by security.
